{"cc":[{"text":"Thick painful toenails. Patient is here for nail care.", "start_char":57, "end_char":106}], "hpi":[{"text":"71-year-old female with diabetes presents for routine nail debridement.
Reports her nails have been increasingly difficult to manage and are
causing pain in shoes. No drainage, no acute injury. Last seen for
nail care five months ago.", "start_char":128, "end_char":303}], "exam_findings":[{"text":"All ten toenails thickened with subungual debris consistent with
onychomycosis. No ulcerations, no surrounding cellulitis. Pedal
pulses palpable bilaterally.", "start_char":317, "end_char":450}], "mdm":[{"text":"Patient meets criteria for routine debridement of mycotic nails.
Discussed risks and benefits of the procedure including bleeding,
infection, and discomfort. Patient consents to nail debridement.
Will continue to monitor diabetes-related foot health at follow-up
visits.", "start_char":465, "end_char":654}], "procedure_note":[{"text":"Following informed consent: ten dystrophic toenails were debrided
using sterile technique. Nail thickness reduced. Patient tolerated
well. No complications.", "start_char":666, "end_char":799}], "ambiguous_segments":[]}
